text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Agnes Digital,
I was dragged to an "Uma Musume-chan Shop."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
They're in stock! They're totally in stoooock!
The new Umamusume lottery tickets!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Our target is the Prize A Student Council Tapestry!
Uuu~! I'm getting so nervousss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bee-bee-bee-bee-beep-beep!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyo!?
Isn't that coming from my body?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Operation is normal, and data is being received.
Heheh, excellent...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heart rate at 110 beats per minute.
Hmph, to think that just getting worked up
equates to the exercise intensity of a jog is fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Tachyon-san!?
Heart rate? Do you mean mine...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While you were fast asleep last night,
I took the liberty of attaching a micro-device to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
While I was asleep...!?
Y-You crept up close to me...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You have something like a mole on the nape of your neck, right?
It shouldn't be painful, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
M-My neck...!?
Abah, ababababaaa~~!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BEEEEEEEEEEEEP!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A massive surge of dopamine from mere imagination!?
Heheh, your pulse chart is spiking so violently
it could easily be mistaken for being in the middle of a race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fuhee, fuhee!
S-Sorry... I've finally calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Such toughness, enduring severe fluctuations in a short span of time...
Your heart truly is fascinating, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's bring them back into an excited state once more.
The more data samples we have, the better!
choice_data_list: If you win Prize A, that might get you hyped...
Please don't push yourself any further!
Please don't push yourself any further!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's bring them back into an excited state once more.
The more data samples we have, the better!
choice_data_list: If you win Prize A, that might get you hyped...
Please don't push yourself any further!
Please don't push yourself any further!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so this lottery ticket is for Prize A, is it?
Then allow me to win it and present it to Digital-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eh, what!? Tachyon-san entered the raffle... for me...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I provide Prize A, you provide data.
In short, it is an equivalent exchange; there is no need for concern."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa!? If-if you do something like that, Digi-tan will...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Statistically speaking, the chance for Prize A is around 2%...
However, there is always room to intervene in any phenomenon.
At least, with my scientific prowess.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the culmination of research!
The ultimate crystallization of wisdom and scientific mastery!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. No cheating allowed.
Sadly, it was just the G-prize clear file."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Please take this as a token of thanks for the experiment—
Oh? Digital-kun?"
(Beep... beep-beep... beep... pshhhhh~)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the paradise of the three thousand worlds where the virtuous are invited?
Or the underground where nerds who receive gifts from Umamusume-chans are punished?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Buuut, as long as there are Umamusume around, no problem at all! Where are the Umamusume~~? Ehehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To be so thrilled as to affect the mesolimbic pathway.
Good grief, it wasn't even the A prize, how utterly bizarre!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, Agnes Digital continued to wander through a dream world.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief... By my estimation, Digital-kun's limits are still far ahead, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, out of deference to your overprotective Trainer,
I'll call it a day here. I've gathered my data, after all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us remove the micro-devices.
Digital-kun, excuse me around the neck.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
H-Hawawa...!? Tachyon-san!
Doing that in your awakened state is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BEEEEEEEEEEEEP!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa~~h!!
My cells are boiling overrr~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haha, new data is accumulating! Accidents like this are more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time the experiment ended, Agnes Digital was
utterly exhausted, yet she had a look of pure bliss on her face.
